d: In Kaliyug, the powerful asura Aham traps devotees and divine beings inside a mysterious mercury world, believing no force can defeat him. To rescue them, Mahaprabhu Jagannath, along with Balaram and Garud, journeys across realms and confronts Aham with wisdom instead of destruction. The story ultimately celebrates the eternal truth that pure devotion can never be defeated, and the divine always protects true faith.
